shloka_text: यामेव रात्रिं शत्रुघ्नः पर्णशालामुपाविशत् । तामेव रात्रिं सीतापि प्रसूता दारकद्वयम् ।। 7.66.1 ।।
transliteration: yāmeva rātriṃ śatrughnaḥ parṇaśālāmupāviśat | tāmeva rātriṃ sītāpi prasūtā dārakadvayam || 7.66.1 ||
translation: यामेव the very same, रात्रिम् night, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, पर्णशालाम् the hermitage, उपाविशत् entered, तामेव the very same, रात्रिम् night, सीतापि Sita also, प्रसूता gave birth, दारकद्वयम् to two sons.
explanation: The very same night that Shatrughna stayed in the hermitage, Sita also gave birth to two sons.
comments: That very night Sita bears twin sons at the hermitage, and Valmiki performs the protective rites, naming the elder Kusha and the younger Lava -- Shatrughna hears the joyful news and congratulates Sita, then at dawn departs westward and reaches the sages' hermitage on the Yamuna.

shloka_text: ततो ऽर्धरात्रसमये बालका मुनिदारकाः । वाल्मीकेः प्रियमाचख्युः सीतायाः प्रसवं शुभम् ।। 7.66.2 ।।
transliteration: tato 'rdharātrasamaye bālakā munidārakāḥ | vālmīkeḥ priyamācakhyuḥ sītāyāḥ prasavaṃ śubham || 7.66.2 ||
translation: ततो then, अर्धरात्रसमये at midnight, बालकाः boys, मुनिदारकाः hermitage boys, वाल्मीकेः to Valmiki, प्रियम् the pleasing news, आचख्युः announced, सीतायाः of Sita, प्रसवम् the birth, शुभम् auspicious.
explanation: Then, at midnight, the hermitage boys announced the auspicious birth of Sita's children to Valmiki.

shloka_text: भगवन्रामपत्नी सा प्रसूता दारकद्वयम् । ततो रक्षां महातेजः कुरु भूतविनाशिनीम् ।। 7.66.3 ।।
transliteration: bhagavanrāmapatnī sā prasūtā dārakadvayam | tato rakṣāṃ mahātejaḥ kuru bhūtavināśinīm || 7.66.3 ||
translation: भगवन् O revered one, रामपत्नी Rama's wife, सा she, प्रसूता has given birth, दारकद्वयम् to two sons, ततो therefore, रक्षाम् protection, महातेजः O greatly effulgent one, कुरु perform, भूतविनाशिनीम् that which destroys evil spirits.
explanation: They informed him, "O revered and greatly effulgent one, Rama's wife has given birth to two sons, so please perform the protective rituals that destroy evil spirits."

shloka_text: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महर्षिः समुपागमत् । बालचन्द्रप्रतीकाशौ देवपुत्रौ महौजसौ ।। 7.66.4 ।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maharṣiḥ samupāgamat | bālacandrapratīkāśau devaputrau mahaujasau || 7.66.4 ||
translation: तेषाम् their, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, महर्षिः the great sage, समुपागमत् approached, बालचन्द्रप्रतीकाशौ resembling the young moon, देवपुत्रौ divine sons, महौजसौ greatly powerful.
explanation: Having heard their words, the great sage approached, seeing the two greatly powerful divine sons who resembled the young moon.

shloka_text: जगाम तत्र हृष्टात्मा ददर्श च कुमारकौ । भूतघ्नीं चाकरोत्ताभ्यां रक्षां रक्षोविनाशिनीम् ।। 7.66.5 ।।
transliteration: jagāma tatra hṛṣṭātmā dadarśa ca kumārakau | bhūtaghnīṃ cākarottābhyāṃ rakṣāṃ rakṣovināśinīm || 7.66.5 ||
translation: जगाम went, तत्र there, हृष्टात्मा joyful-souled, ददर्श saw, च and, कुमारकौ the two boys, भूतघ्नीं demon-destroying, च and, अकरोत् he performed, ताभ्यां for them two, रक्षां protection, रक्षोविनाशिनीम् demon-destroying.
explanation: With a joyful mind, he went there, saw the two boys, and performed for them a protection ritual that destroys demons and malevolent spirits.

shloka_text: कुशमुष्टिमुपादाय लवं चैव तु स द्विजः । वाल्मीकिः प्रददौ ताभ्यां रक्षां भूतविनाशिनीम् ।। 7.66.6 ।।
transliteration: kuśamuṣṭimupādāya lavaṃ caiva tu sa dvijaḥ | vālmīkiḥ pradadau tābhyāṃ rakṣāṃ bhūtavināśinīm || 7.66.6 ||
translation: कुशमुष्टिम् a handful of Kuśa grass, उपादाय having taken, लवं a piece, च and, एव indeed, तु and, सः that, द्विजः brahmin, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, प्रददौ gave, ताभ्यां to them two, रक्षां protection, भूतविनाशिनीम् demon-destroying.
explanation: Having taken a handful of Kuśa grass and a piece (of it), that brahmin Valmiki indeed gave to the two boys a protection that destroys demons.

shloka_text: यस्तयोः पूर्वजो जातः स कुशैर्मन्त्रसत्कृतैः । निर्मार्जनीयस्तु तदा कुश इत्यस्य नाम तत् ।। 7.66.7 ।।
transliteration: yastayoḥ pūrvajo jātaḥ sa kuśairmantrasatkṛtaiḥ | nirmārjanīyastu tadā kuśa ityasya nāma tat || 7.66.7 ||
translation: यः who, तयोः of them two, पूर्वजः first-born, जातः was born, सः he, कुशैः with Kuśa grass, मन्त्रसत्कृतैः consecrated with mantras, निर्मार्जनीयः was to be purified, तु and, तदा then, कुशः Kuśa, इति thus, अस्य his, नाम name, तत् that.
explanation: The one who was born first of the two, he was to be purified with Kuśa grass consecrated by mantras, and thus his name became Kuśa.

shloka_text: यश्चावरो भवेत्ताभ्यां लवेन स समाहितः । निर्मार्जनीयो वृद्धाभिर्लव इत्येव नामतः ।। 7.66.8 ।।
transliteration: yaścāvaro bhavettābhyāṃ lavena sa samāhitaḥ | nirmārjanīyo vṛddhābhirlava ityeva nāmataḥ || 7.66.8 ||
translation: यः who, च and, अवरः younger, भवेत् was, ताभ्यां of them two, लवेन with a piece, सः he, समाहितः carefully, निर्मार्जनीयः was to be purified, वृद्धाभिः by old women, लवः Lava, इति thus, एव indeed, नामतः by name.
explanation: And the one who was younger of the two, he was carefully purified with a piece (of Kuśa grass) by the old women, and thus he was named Lava.

shloka_text: एवं कुशलवौ नाम्ना तावुभौ यमजातकौ । मत्कृताभ्यां च नामभ्यां ख्यातियुक्तौ भविष्यतः ।। 7.66.9 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ kuśalavau nāmnā tāvubhau yamajātakau | matkṛtābhyāṃ ca nāmabhyāṃ khyātiyuktau bhaviṣyataḥ || 7.66.9 ||
translation: एवं thus, कुशलवौ Kuśa and Lava, नाम्ना by name, तौ those, उभौ both, यमजातकौ born as twins, मत्कृताभ्यां given by me, च and, नामभ्यां by names, ख्यातिमुक्तौ renowned, भविष्यतः will become.
explanation: Thus, these two, born as twins, will be known by the names Kuśa and Lava, and will become renowned by these names given by me.

shloka_text: तां रक्षां जगृहुस्ताश्च मुनिहस्तात्समाहिताः । अकुर्वंश्च ततो रक्षां तयोर्विगतकल्मषाः ।। 7.66.10 ।।
transliteration: tāṃ rakṣāṃ jagṛhustāśca munihastātsamāhitāḥ | akurvaṃśca tato rakṣāṃ tayorvigatakalmaṣāḥ || 7.66.10 ||
translation: तां that, रक्षां protection, जगृहुः they took, ताः they (the women), च and, मुनिहस्तात् from the hands of the sage, समाहिताः attentive, अकुर्वंश्च and they performed, ततः then, रक्षां protection, तयोः for the two (newborns), विगतकल्मषाः purified.
explanation: The attentive women took the protective charm from the sage's hands and, being purified, then performed the protective rites for the two newborns.

shloka_text: तथा तां क्रियमाणां च वृद्धाभिर्जन्म नाम च । सङ्कीर्तनं च रामस्य सीतायाः प्रसवौ शुभौ ।। 7.66.11 ।।
transliteration: tathā tāṃ kriyamāṇāṃ ca vṛddhābhirjanma nāma ca | saṅkīrtanaṃ ca rāmasya sītāyāḥ prasavau śubhau || 7.66.11 ||
translation: तथा thus, तां that, क्रियमाणां being performed, च and, वृद्धाभिः by the elderly women, जन्म birth, नाम name, च and, सङ्कीर्तनं chanting, च and, रामस्य of Rama, सीतायाः of Sita, प्रसवौ the two births, शुभौ auspicious.
explanation: Thus, while that (protection) was being performed by the elderly women, there was also chanting of Rama's name and glorification of Sita's two auspicious births.

shloka_text: अर्धरात्रे तु शत्रुघ्नः शुश्राव सुमहत्प्रियम् । पर्णशालां ततो गत्वा मातर्दिष्ट्येति चाब्रवीत् ।। 7.66.12 ।।
transliteration: ardharātre tu śatrughnaḥ śuśrāva sumahatpriyam | parṇaśālāṃ tato gatvā mātardiṣṭyeti cābravīt || 7.66.12 ||
translation: अर्धरात्रे at midnight, तु indeed, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, शुश्राव heard, सुमहत्प्रियम् very great good news, पर्णशालां to the hermitage, ततः then, गत्वा having gone, मातः O mother, दिष्ट्या fortunately, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् he said.
explanation: At midnight, Shatrughna heard the very great good news, and then, having gone to the hermitage, he said to Sita, "O mother, fortunately!"

shloka_text: तथा तस्य प्रहृष्टस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः । व्यतीता वार्षिकी रात्रिः श्रावणी लघुविक्रमः ।। 7.66.13 ।।
transliteration: tathā tasya prahṛṣṭasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ | vyatītā vārṣikī rātriḥ śrāvaṇī laghuvikramaḥ || 7.66.13 ||
translation: तथा thus, तस्य his, प्रहृष्टस्य overjoyed, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, व्यतीता passed, वार्षिकी rainy season's, रात्रिः night, श्रावणी of Shravana, लघुविक्रमः swiftly.
explanation: Thus, for the overjoyed, great-souled Shatrughna, the night of Shravana, which marked the rainy season, passed swiftly.

shloka_text: प्रभाते सुमहावीर्यः कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकीं क्रियाम् । मुनिं प्राञ्जलिरामन्त्र्य ययौ पश्चान्मुखः पुनः ।। 7.66.14 ।।
transliteration: prabhāte sumahāvīryaḥ kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīṃ kriyām | muniṃ prāñjalirāmantrya yayau paścānmukhaḥ punaḥ || 7.66.14 ||
translation: प्रभाते in the morning, सुमहावीर्यः the very mighty (Shatrughna), कृत्वा having performed, पौर्वाह्णिकीं morning's, क्रियाम् rites, मुनिं the sage, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, आमन्त्र्य having bid farewell, ययौ he went, पश्चान्मुखः facing west, पुनः again.
explanation: In the morning, the very mighty Shatrughna, having performed his morning rites and having bid farewell to the sage with folded hands, again departed, facing west.

shloka_text: स गत्वा यमुनातीरं सप्तरात्रोषितः पथि । ऋषीणां पुण्यकीर्तीनामाश्रमे वासमभ्ययात् ।। 7.66.15 ।।
transliteration: sa gatvā yamunātīraṃ saptarātroṣitaḥ pathi | ṛṣīṇāṃ puṇyakīrtīnāmāśrame vāsamabhyayāt || 7.66.15 ||
translation: स he, गत्वा having gone, यमुनातीरं to the bank of Yamuna, सप्तरात्रोषितः having stayed for seven nights, पथि on the way, ऋषीणां of the sages, पुण्यकीर्तीनाम् of pure fame, आश्रमे in the hermitage, वासम residence, अभ्ययात् he obtained.
explanation: Having traveled and stayed for seven nights on the way, he reached the bank of the Yamuna and obtained residence in the hermitage of the sages of pure fame.

shloka_text: स तत्र मुनिभिः सार्धं भार्गवप्रमुखैर्नृपः । कथाभिरभिरूपाभिर्वासं चक्रे महायशाः ।। 7.66.16 ।।
transliteration: sa tatra munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhārgavapramukhairnṛpaḥ | kathābhirabhirūpābhirvāsaṃ cakre mahāyaśāḥ || 7.66.16 ||
translation: स he, तत्र there, मुनिभिः with the sages, सार्धं together, भार्गवप्रमुखैः with Bhargava (Chyavana) as the chief, नृपः the king, कथाभिः with stories, अभिरूपाभिः delightful, वासं his stay, चक्रे he made, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.
explanation: There, the greatly renowned king spent his stay with the sages, led by Bhargava, engaging in delightful conversations.

shloka_text: स काञ्चनाद्यैर्मुनिभिः समेतो रघुप्रवीरो रजनीं तदानीम् । कथाप्रकारैर्बहुभिर्महात्मा विरामयामास नरेन्द्रसूनुः ।। 7.66.17 ।।
transliteration: sa kāñcanādyairmunibhiḥ sameto raghupravīro rajanīṃ tadānīm | kathāprakārairbahubhirmahātmā virāmayāmāsa narendrasūnuḥ || 7.66.17 ||
translation: स he, काञ्चनाद्यैः with Kanchana and others, मुनिभिः with the sages, समेतः accompanied by, रघुप्रवीरः the hero of Raghu's lineage, रजनीं the night, तदानीम् then, कथाप्रकारैः with various kinds of stories, बहुभिः many, महात्मा the great-souled one, विरामयामास he passed, नरेन्द्रसूनुः the son of the king.
explanation: Then, the great-souled Shatrughna, the hero of Raghu's lineage and son of the king, accompanied by sages like Kanchana and others, passed the night with many kinds of stories. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमः सर्गः ।। 66 ।। Thus ends the sixty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
